doc: Field villager behaviour (M3-CRE-610, docs/kb/tech/field_npc.md): FieldNpc (game/world/npc/field_npc.gd) idles, talks, turns to face the player and walks short routes. Metres, seconds, degrees. `defaults` apply to every villager; `villagers.<npc_id>` overrides any key (nested dictionaries merge). `locomotion` is merged over game/data/hero_motion/hero_motion.json and handed to HeroLocomotion, so the turn and the gait filter are the hero maths with villager tuning. M3-CRE-613 adds the routines: `look` (the NpcLook head modifier), `glance` (at a party that comes near), `look_around` (an idle look to one side now and then), `chat` (two villagers with chat_with take turns), `work` (a work clip at rest and where the head looks), `storm` (set_storm: the reaction delay, the hurry to shelter, the brace and the looks at the sky). A [min, max] pair is drawn per villager and per occurrence from a hash of its id (no randomness).

locomotion.doc: Villagers turn slower and softer than the heroes, and their gait filter is longer so a start or a stop rolls through the walk. walk_clip_mps: the speed at which the villager walk clip's feet plant (measured from the M2-CHR-03 adult walk: ~0.37 m of foot travel per 0.55 s stance).

defaults.idle_playback_doc: Each villager idles (and works) at its own rate in this range, drawn from its id (FieldNpc.idle_rate): out of pace as well as out of phase (the Lead's crowd behaviour pass, 2026-10-30).

look.doc: NpcLook: the neck and head turn by yaw (about up) and pitch (about the body's side) shared over `bones`, eased by a critically damped spring over smoothing_sec with the speed capped. A target past max_yaw_deg is out of reach: the villager doesn't strain to glance behind itself. head_height_m: the eye height above the node it aims from; player_eye_height_m: where on the player it looks.

glance.doc: When the party comes within radius_m the villager's head turns to it for hold_sec, then again every rest_sec while it stays near (only when the head can reach it).

look_around.doc: At rest with nothing to attend to: every every_sec a slow look up to yaw_deg to one side, held hold_sec.

chat.doc: Two villagers with chat_with, both resting within max_distance_m, face each other and take turns of turn_sec; pause_share of the turns are a shared silence. The pair's lead (its id sorts first) runs the schedule. bout_sec and quiet_sec: they chat in bouts and go back to their own business (work, looking about) in between.

storm.doc: set_storm(true): after react_sec (per villager) it hurries (walk_speed_mps) to its shelter point if it has one, else braces where it stands. Braced: the head down brace_pitch_deg and partly turned (brace_yaw_share) toward look_azimuth_deg (clockwise from north, as zone_weather.json; omitted: straight ahead); every sky_every_sec it looks up sky_pitch_deg for sky_look_sec. idle_playback: the idle (or storm clip) runs a little quicker, uneasy. set_storm(false) walks it home.

osu.doc: The elder: a slower turn, a longer settle back to rest.

work.doc: Mending a net across the knees: the head down on the hands.
Sweeping the chapel court: the head on the broom's sweep.
